title: Disappointing purchase!
text: Disappointing purchase!. I have a painting in my bathroom that is very close to the one pictured on bath mat.  I was excited to find this.  However, when item arrived, I was so disappointed by the size, and quality of this product. I should return but that’s more of a hassle.
